scope: formal non-pilot FIT/DEV sample only; no formal TEST bodies or predictions inspected
user_transfer_authorization: User explicitly authorized return and audit of these 50 public articles in the main chat before local review.

selection_rule.primary: For each corpus × FIT/DEV, take the first per_stratum articles ordered by SHA256(seed + ':' + source_id), then source_id
selection_rule.exclude_pilot: Exclude every pilot source_id using the checksum-verified metadata-only source-keys.json
selection_rule.supplement: For each eligible Dolma3 source_group × FIT/DEV absent from the primary sample, add its minimum SHA256 rank article
selection_rule.test: TEST bodies never enter candidate pools or exported samples; no TEST predictions are opened

failure_reason: At least one selected formal FIT article is a real SEO/search-fragment splice, violating the frozen article boundary.

protocol_note: Pilot scan/data and existing formal files were not modified by this audit. Any formal-data correction must be a recorded protocol/data-version amendment; do not silently remove only this ID, redraw a passing sample, alter TEST based on outcomes, or claim this sample passed.
limitations: Finite LLM-agent review is not a human annotation or corpus-wide purity guarantee.
Only selected non-pilot FIT/DEV articles and proof metadata were read locally; the full formal sources/TEST corpus was not opened.
Global minimum-rank selection is supported by the bound remote selector proof; local verification covers selected ranks, text hashes, strata and disjointness from pilot IDs.
Factual accuracy, subject matter and general writing quality were not used as additional rejection rules.
